summary.text: Corinne Cascadden is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Coos 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the Republican incumbent is Lori Korzen.
A longtime educator and former school superintendent, she previously served in the House from 2022 to 2024 representing Coos 5.

paragraphs.text: Corinne Cascadden was born in Berlin, New Hampshire, and earned a doctorate in education leadership.

Ballotpedia lists her education as including a bachelor's degree from Plymouth State College, graduate study at Plymouth State College and the University of New Hampshire, and a Ph.D. from Nova Southeastern University.

Her career experience includes working as a school principal, as superintendent of SAU 3 in Berlin, as interim superintendent in SAU 84 Littleton and SAU 76 Lyme, and as an independent school consultant.
In 2020 she was appointed to the New Hampshire School Funding Commission.
Cascadden served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, representing Coos 5, from 2022 to 2024, and during the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the House Education Committee.
